newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BBAG POSTED HIGHER EARNINGS PER SHARE IN 1996
newsitem.headline: BBAG POSTED HIGHER EARNINGS PER SHARE IN 1996

text.p: VIENNA, May 14 (Reuter) Austrian drinks group BBAG and its unit Brau Union posted higher earnings per share last year, the Association of Austrian Analysts (OeVFA) said on Wednesday.
BBAG earnings per share rose to 47 schillings in 1996 from 44 schillings in 1995, OeVFA said in a statement. Cash earnings per share were 222 schillings after 172.
Brau Union earnings per share climbed to 56 schillings from 48 while cash earnings increased to 156 schillings from 142. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
